name: RELLIS-3D — Multimodal Off-Road Autonomous Driving Dataset
description: Multi-modal off-road robot navigation dataset created by the Unmanned Systems Laboratory at Texas A&M University. Collected on the RELLIS Campus using a Clearpath Robotics Warthog unmanned ground vehicle equipped with an Ouster OS1-64 LiDAR, a high-resolution RGB camera, and GPS/IMU navigation sensors. Contains 13,556 LiDAR scans and 6,235 camera images labeled with 20 class-level semantic annotations tailored to off-road terrain traversability, grass, bushes, puddles, and mud.
